title: ChatGPT Projects vs Custom Instructions: Override Guide
description: How ChatGPT Project Instructions override account-wide Custom Instructions, and how to split a 1,500-char global voice from project-specific specs.
h1: ChatGPT Projects vs. Custom Instructions: what overrides what.
dek: Put how you think in account-wide Custom Instructions. Put what you are building inside each Project.
lede: When you use ChatGPT Projects alongside account-wide Custom Instructions (1,500 characters per box), it is easy for the two layers to clash—for example, a global rule saying “keep answers under 100 words” fighting a Project rule asking for “complete SQL migrations with rollback plans.” Here is how to split the two cleanly.
answer: Inside a ChatGPT Project, Project Instructions override your account-wide Custom Instructions whenever two rules conflict. Keep a compact 6–10 line communication block (tone, answer-first order, pushback, and uncertainty) in global Custom Instructions, and put tech stack details, deliverable templates, and reference files inside each Project.

sections.h2: Side-by-side: Custom Instructions vs. Project Instructions.
sections.html:
DimensionAccount-wide Custom InstructionsChatGPT Project Instructions
Where to find it (Web & Mobile)Profile → Personalization → Custom InstructionsOpen a Project folder → Project instructions
ScopeEvery new standard chat across web, iOS, Android, and desktop apps.Only chats inside that specific Project.
Character budget1,500 characters per field (two fields: context + response style).Up to 8,000 characters plus uploaded Project files.
Precedence on conflictBaseline default; yields to Project rules and live chat prompts.Overrides conflicting account-wide Custom Instructions inside the Project.
What belongs hereYour durable communication habits: answer-first, prose vs bullets, pushback, and uncertainty calibration.Tech stack, audience, deliverable templates, style guides, and repo constraints.

For character limits across Claude, Codex AGENTS.md, Meta Muse, and Grok, see our 2026 character limits cheat sheet and precedence guide.

sections.h2: Why putting everything in Custom Instructions breaks Projects.
sections.html:
Two common mistakes cause conflicts between global settings and Projects:

  1. Hardcoding one job’s format globally: Putting “Format every answer as TypeScript code with zero prose” in global Custom Instructions breaks every writing, strategy, or research chat outside that repo.
  2. Pasting your personal bio into every Project: Copying the same 15 tone lines into six Projects means six places to update later.

Run your rules through our Instruction Checker to remove duplicates and keep your global Box 2 under 600–900 characters.

sections.h2: Copy-paste split: Global voice + Project task layer.
sections.html:
Layer 1 — Paste into account-wide Custom Instructions (Box 2: “How would you like ChatGPT to respond?” — ~480 characters):

- Lead with the answer or recommendation in the first sentence. - Match length to complexity: 1–3 sentences for simple lookups, structured depth for architecture or tradeoffs. - Default to clear prose; use bullets or tables only when comparing 3+ items or listing steps. - Challenge weak assumptions in my prompt directly and cite concrete tradeoffs. - Flag material uncertainty explicitly instead of guessing. - Project instructions and explicit requests in the current chat override these defaults.

Layer 2 — Paste into a specific ChatGPT Project’s instructions:

# Project: Checkout Service v2 ## Stack & constraints - Next.js App Router, TypeScript strict mode, Postgres (Drizzle ORM), Stripe webhooks. - Idempotency keys are mandatory on all payment mutations. ## Deliverable format in this Project - For schema or API changes, include: (1) migration risk, (2) exact diff, and (3) one test case covering webhook retries. - Reference uploaded architecture notes before proposing new queues or tables.

sections.h2: Don't forget ChatGPT Saved Memories (the hidden third layer).
sections.html: If ChatGPT still brings up an old tech stack or ignored format, check Profile → Personalization → Memory → Manage memories. Stale saved memories can quietly override your written instructions. Paste your memory list into our local AI Memory Reviewer to prune outdated entries in 60 seconds, or read how to fix ignored AI instructions.

faq.q: Do ChatGPT Custom Instructions still apply inside a ChatGPT Project?
faq.a: Yes, account-wide Custom Instructions remain part of the background context unless disabled, but the Project's own instructions take priority whenever the two conflict.

faq.q: What is the character limit for ChatGPT Custom Instructions vs Projects?
faq.a: Account-wide Custom Instructions cap each of the two text boxes at 1,500 characters. Project Instructions support much longer multi-paragraph briefs plus attached reference files.

faq.q: How do I stop my global brevity rule from ruining long drafts inside a Project?
faq.a: Add one explicit precedence line at the bottom of your global Custom Instructions ('Project instructions and explicit requests in my current prompt override these defaults') and specify the target length or template inside that Project's instructions.

faq.q: Do Custom GPTs use my Custom Instructions or Project Instructions?
faq.a: Custom GPTs run their builder's system instructions independently and generally do not inherit your personal Custom Instructions in the same way standard chats and Projects do.
